Lena (People Ops): Heads-up 1: manager asked to make an L3->L4 leveling effective 2026-05-01 but evidence uploaded today (2026-05-20). Question: can we set benefits eligibility and 401k match to the retro date too?
Alex (Eng Manager): We want comp + benefits to align with the effective date. Candidate hit milestone earlier but docs were late.
Sam (Comp & Benefits): Quick policy note: base comp retro is allowed within 30 days with approvals. Benefits enrollment changes (medical, 401k match) follow vendor rules some vendors only allow changes at start of month or require enrollment window. Need benefits ops check.
Ravi (Payroll): Payroll can handle salary retro, but 401k match recalcs need HR vendor recalculation. If retro spans a prior payroll period, we create an off-cycle adjustment for employer match. That needs: employee_id, retro_period_start, retro_amount, and vendor_case_id.
Alex (Eng Manager): What's the minimum manager attestation we need?
Lena (People Ops): Manager must confirm 1) evidence timestamp and summary, 2) no overlapping promotions for same headcount, 3) there was no previously denied leveling for same person. A quick attestation sentence is fine.
Sam (Comp & Benefits): Also flag potential tax withholding changes for equity if grant vest/strike dates change. Comp counsel sometimes needs to update tax docs.
hr-bot: New HR case #PO-2026-932 created by Lena. Attachments: manager_attestation.pdf, peer_feedback.txt
Ravi (Payroll): Action list from payroll side:
- Submit retro payroll form with fields:
```
employee_id: 67890
effective_date: 2026-05-01
retro_type: salary_promotion
retro_amount: 1250.00
payroll_code: PR-RT-051
vendor_case: HRV-3312
```
- If 401k match required: open vendor ticket with vendor_case and include pay periods impacted.
Alex (Eng Manager): I'll add attestation to the case and ping benefits ops for vendor ticket.
Sam (Comp & Benefits): I'll review the attestation + check vendor constraints. If vendor won't backdate match, we can do employer adjustment via off-cycle and annotate in the employee record.
Lena (People Ops): Thanks. One more: equity recalcs  Sam, can comp trigger grant regen?
Sam (Comp & Benefits): Yes, but we need Legal signoff for any change to grant effective date. Timeline usually 7-14 business days. I'll queue comp counsel if we approve retro >14 days.
Alex (Eng Manager): Sounds good. Will notify the individual with tentative dates.
Lena (People Ops): Summary next steps: manager upload attestation, Alex to request vendor match ticket, Sam to confirm vendor feasibility and Legal if needed, Ravi to prepare payroll retro once approved. I'll update case #PO-2026-932. :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Payroll): Copy that. If anyone needs sample language for attestation I can paste a template.
Alex (Eng Manager): Please do, that would help.
Ravi (Payroll): Template: "I confirm that [employee name] met the performance milestones for L4 on 2026-05-01 and there were no prior denials. Evidence: link-to-docs. Manager: Alex"
Lena (People Ops): Perfect, thanks all. Closing loop once vendor confirms.
